questions.prompt: A subnet has Microsoft.Storage enabled as a service endpoint. A storage account still allows all public networks. What change restricts its intended ordinary access to that subnet?

options.text: Configure the account's selected-network rules to allow the subnet.
options.explanation: The service-side rule is needed in addition to the subnet endpoint.

options.text: Only rename the subnet to StorageSubnet.
options.explanation: A name does not enforce a service firewall rule.

options.text: Add a CNAME record for the storage hostname.
options.explanation: DNS aliases do not restrict permitted networks.

options.text: Grant the VM Owner on its resource group.
options.explanation: Management authorization does not restrict account network access.

questions.prompt: Which statement describes a classic service endpoint for an Azure Storage subnet?

options.text: It creates a dedicated private IP for the storage account in that subnet.
It identifies the subnet to the service while using the service's public endpoint.
options.explanation: It extends network identity without creating a private endpoint NIC.

options.text: It automatically grants blob read permission to subnet users.
It turns every on-premises VPN client into a member of the allowed subnet.
options.explanation: On-premises traffic does not gain that endpoint identity.

questions.prompt: A VM's subnet endpoint and storage network rule are correct, but its identity has no blob data permission. Can it read a private blob using Entra authentication?

options.text: Yes; service endpoints grant Blob Data Reader.
options.explanation: The endpoint supplies a network path, not that role.

options.text: Yes; an NSG allow grants storage data access.
options.explanation: NSGs filter packets rather than authorize blobs.

options.text: No; assign the appropriate blob data authorization too.
options.explanation: Network permission and data permission are separate requirements.

options.text: Yes; selected networks make private containers anonymous.
options.explanation: Container access level is independent of the selected-network rule.
